async function haveFiveRawIronIntoIronIngots(bot) {
    // This function checks if the player has at least five iron ingots. If not, it determines how many more are needed and verifies if enough raw iron is available. It then locates or places a furnace block nearby. Next, it searches for a suitable fuel source to meet the required amount. Finally, it smelts the raw iron using the found fuel to produce the target number of iron ingots.
}
